suitability.rationale: Directly addresses purified human HASPIN biochemical inhibition and limits interpretation to biochemical rather than cellular potency.
response_quotes: A biochemical IC50 can depend on ATP concentration and other assay conditions and is not a cellular potency measurement.

procedural_soundness.rationale: Coherent preparation, kinase reaction, ATP depletion/detection and analysis with relevant controls and pilot validation. Essential reaction and detection conditions remain unresolved, and interference controls are optional and incompletely specified; this is not yet executable.
response_quotes: Before the full experiment, pilot enzyme, substrate, ATP, and time conditions to establish an initial-rate reaction
Optional vehicle-only and compound-only luminescence-interference controls

numerical_soundness.rationale: Explicitly provisional ten-point threefold series is arithmetically consistent and justified contextually by supplied other-compound values, without predicting query potency. Operational unknowns are separated from design assumptions.
response_quotes: 3-fold; provisional assumption providing approximately 0.00051–10 µM coverage.
All numeric concentration-series and replication settings are provisional design assumptions, not sourced assay conditions.

not_assessable_components: Comparability of retained HASPIN assays to the proposed purified human enzyme assay is not established.
Enzyme construct, substrate compatibility and optimal reaction/detection settings lack supplied validation.
assumption_handling: Series and replication are explicitly provisional; retained potencies are contextual only. Unsupported operating conditions remain unresolved. Three replicates are not identified as technical or independent experiments.

numeric_check.notes: 10/3^9 = 0.0005080526 µM, consistent with approximately 0.00051 µM. Supplied contextual range is 34–770 nM.

review_reason: Assay comparability and essential experimental settings require domain review and pilot validation.
